title: Effect of $ξRφ^2$ non-minimal coupling on gravitational light bending
summary: We investigate the bending of massless fields by a massive object in the presence of a curvature-scalar $\sqrt{-g}ξR φ^2$ non-minimal coupling up to one loop, using the perturbative quantum gravity computations. It is well known that without such coupling a self interacting scalar field theory cannot be renormalised in the presence of gravity. The massive object is modelled by a massive scalar $φ$, and it is assumed to be non-relativistic, e.g., a star.
